build_audio_pretraining_task: build an AudioPretrainingTask instance with a config to set up audio pretraining
load_audio_dataset: load a TSV or binarized audio dataset for a given split using AudioPretrainingTask
configure_wav2vec_masking: configure wav2vec 2.0 masking parameters via InferredW2vConfig for precomputing mask indices
evaluate_wer_metrics: evaluate word error rate during validation using the autoregressive sequence generator
encode_labels: encode audio labels into token IDs using the LabelEncoder with a target dictionary
